Medicare help in every Kentucky county

Honorbrook Insurance is licensed in Kentucky and helps residents of all 120 counties compare Medicare, ACA, life and retirement coverage by phone or video call. Statewide, about 55.5% of people with Medicare are enrolled in a Medicare Advantage plan (CMS, September 2026).

Schedule a Medicare review

Booking opens Luay’s page on PlanEnroll. Create your profile there and ask for your meeting. Having these ready makes the first conversation useful:

  • Your Medicare card, or the dates your Part A and Part B start.
  • The doctors and hospitals you want to keep.
  • A list of your prescriptions and the pharmacy you use.
  • Whether you have Medicaid or get help paying Medicare costs.

When PlanEnroll asks what type of meeting you would like, choose Health. You may be asked to complete a short Scope of Appointment form first. It does not obligate you to enroll. The first open time is at least 24 hours ahead. To talk sooner, call (301) 615-8289 or text (571) 354-0146.
